'''Zarran Imports and Exports''' was a business that operated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The business was owned by [[Shass (Neimoidian)|Shass]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who had formerly worked for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
